meta.name: Da Bai Fen Lite
meta.blurb: Partnership trick-taking, NS against EW, over 4 hands of 7 tricks with a 30-card deck, jokers and a hidden kitty.

setup.label: the teams
setup.text: Seats 1 and 3 are Team NS. Seats 2 and 4 are Team EW.

steps.label: a new hand
steps.text: Hand {hand_number} of {hands} begins. Seat {declarer} is the declarer; Team {declaring_team} declares.

steps.label: the deal
steps.text: Each player is dealt {cards_dealt_each} cards. The other {kitty_size} cards go face down to the kitty.

steps.label: name the trump suit
steps.text: You are the declarer. Name the trump suit: Spades, Hearts, Clubs or Diamonds. Both jokers and all 7 cards of that suit will be trumps, and you lead the first trick.

steps.label: clear the trick

rules:
Seats 1, 2, 3 and 4 sit in anticlockwise order. Seats 1 and 3 are Team NS; seats 2 and 4 are Team EW. Partners cannot see each other's cards. There is no talk; the only communication is the cards played.

DECK. {deck_size} cards: four suits (Spades, Hearts, Clubs, Diamonds) of {cards_per_suit} cards each: 5, 8, 10, J, Q, K, A, with rank values 5={rank_5}, 8={rank_8}, 10={rank_10}, J={rank_j}, Q={rank_q}, K={rank_k}, A={rank_a}; plus the Big Joker (BJ) and the Small Joker (SJ). Each K is worth {points_k} points, each 10 {points_10}, each 5 {points_5}; all other cards and both jokers are worth {points_other}. The deck holds {total_points} points.

MATCH. {hands} hands of {rounds_per_hand} rounds each, {total_rounds} rounds in total. The declarer is seat 1 in hand 1, seat 2 in hand 2, seat 3 in hand 3 and seat 4 in hand 4. The declarer's team is the Declaring Team; the other is the Defending Team.

ROUND 1 OF EACH HAND. The cards are shuffled. Each player privately receives {cards_dealt_each} cards; the remaining {kitty_size} cards form the face-down kitty, which no one sees. The declarer names one suit as trumps, announced to all. Trumps are BJ, SJ and the 7 cards of the trump suit, {trump_count} cards in all, and for following they all form one suit, Trump. The declarer leads the first trick.

ROUNDS 2 TO 8 (ONE TRICK EACH). The leader plays any card face up; its suit is the led suit, or Trump if it is a trump. The other three then play one card each in anticlockwise order from the leader, each seeing the cards already played. A player holding a card of the led suit must play one (you are offered only those cards); a player holding none may play any card. Strength: BJ = {big_joker_strength}, SJ = {small_joker_strength}, a trump-suit card = {trump_base} + rank, a non-trump card of the led suit = {led_suit_base} + rank, any other card = rank. The highest strength wins the trick (ties cannot occur); the winner's team adds the points of the four cards to its hand points, and the winner leads the next trick. In round 8, after the last trick the kitty is revealed and its points go to the team that won that trick.

END OF HAND. Let P be the Defending Team's hand points. P from 0 to {band_declarer_3_max}: Declaring Team +{award_3} match points. P from {band_declarer_2_min} to {band_declarer_2_max}: Declaring Team +{award_2}. P from {band_defender_1_min} to {band_defender_1_max}: Defending Team +{award_1}. P from {band_defender_2_min} to {band_defender_2_max}: Defending Team +{award_2}. P from {band_defender_3_min} to {total_points}: Defending Team +{award_3}. Each team also adds its hand points to its running card-point total; hand points then reset to 0 for the next hand.

WINNING. After hand {hands}, the team with more match points wins, and both its players win. If match points are equal, the team with the higher card-point total wins. If that is also equal, the match is a draw (all four share the win).
